title: JR渋谷駅のホームから改札 (ハチ公・中央・南・新南)へのアクセス
titleTranslation: Access from the JR Shibuya Station Platforms to the Ticket Gates
summary: The article explains, in easy Japanese, how to get from the platforms of JR Shibuya Station to its four ticket gates (Hachiko, Central, South, and New South), including nearby shops, restaurants, and train transfer routes at each one.

sentences.text: ここがJR渋谷駅の「ハチ公改札」です！
sentences.translation: Here is the "Hachiko Ticket Gate" at JR Shibuya Station!

sentences.text: スクランブル交差点や、忠犬ハチ公の像に　近い　「ハチ公口」は、　改札を　出て　左へ　行くと　あります。
sentences.translation: The "Hachiko Exit," which is close to the scramble crossing and the statue of the loyal dog Hachiko, is on the left after you exit the ticket gate.

sentences.text: MIYASHITA PARKへ　行くときは、改札を　出て　右にある「宮益坂口」を　使いましょう。
sentences.translation: When going to MIYASHITA PARK, use the "Miyamasuzaka Exit" on the right after exiting the ticket gate.

sentences.text: ハチ公改札の　まわり
sentences.translation: Around the Hachiko Ticket Gate

sentences.text: ハチ公改札の　まわりには　SHIBUYA109やMIYASHITA PARKなど、有名な　場所が　たくさん　あります。
sentences.translation: Around the Hachiko Ticket Gate there are many famous places, such as SHIBUYA109 and MIYASHITA PARK.

sentences.text: 居酒屋や　レストラン、回転寿司屋の「魚べい」や　有名な　ラーメンの　お店「一蘭」、和牛が　食べらる　焼肉店「立喰い焼肉治郎丸」なども　あります。

tokens.gloss: (part of potential/passive form 食べられる, "can be eaten")

sentences.translation: There are also izakaya and restaurants, the conveyor-belt sushi shop "Uobei," the famous ramen shop "Ichiran," and the standing yakiniku restaurant "Tachigui Yakiniku Jiromaru" where you can eat wagyu beef.

sentences.text: さらに、すこし　あるくと　"奥渋谷"と　呼ばれる、しずかな　場所も　あります。
sentences.translation: Also, if you walk a little further, there is a quiet area called "Oku-Shibuya."

sentences.text: 「FUGLEN TOKYO」のような　カフェが　あるので、にぎやかな　渋谷に　疲れたら、奥渋谷で　休んでもいいですね。
sentences.translation: Since there are cafes like "FUGLEN TOKYO," if you get tired of the bustling Shibuya, it's nice to rest in Oku-Shibuya.

sentences.text: | 場所の名前 | 紹介 |
sentences.translation: | Place name | Description |

sentences.text: | SHIBUYA109 | 若い　女の人が　よく　使う　服や　コスメなどを　買える店。
sentences.translation: | SHIBUYA109 | A shop where you can buy clothes, cosmetics, and other things that young women often use.

sentences.text: カフェや　レストランも　ある。
sentences.translation: There are also cafes and restaurants.

sentences.text: | 東急ハンズ | B2Fから　7Fまで　ある　大きな　店。

tokens.gloss: B (basement level prefix, as in B2F)

sentences.translation: | Tokyu Hands | A large store spanning from B2F to 7F.

sentences.text: 生活に　使うものや　コスメ、かばん、　ペンや　日本らしいものなど　いろいろな　ものを　買える。
sentences.translation: You can buy various things such as everyday items, cosmetics, bags, pens, and typically Japanese goods.

sentences.text: | 渋谷センター街 | レストランやカフェ、服の店、ゲームセンターなど　いろいろな　店がある　場所。
sentences.translation: | Shibuya Center Gai | A place with many different kinds of shops, such as restaurants, cafes, clothing stores, and arcades.

sentences.text: スクランブル交差点を　渡った　TSUTAYAの　隣が　入り口。
sentences.translation: The entrance is next to TSUTAYA, across the scramble crossing.

sentences.text: 東京メトロ半蔵門線・東急田園都市線への乗りかえ
sentences.translation: Transferring to the Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line / Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line

sentences.text: 地下鉄「東京メトロ半蔵門線」・「東急田園都市線」へ　乗りかえるときは、「ハチ公改札」から　行くと　わかりやすいです。
sentences.translation: When transferring to the subway "Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line" or "Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line," it's easiest to go from the "Hachiko Ticket Gate."

sentences.text: 改札を　出て　すぐ　右の　階段か、　エスカレーターから　下へ　おります。

tokens.gloss: to go down (colloquial variant of おりる)

sentences.translation: Go down the stairs or escalator right after exiting the ticket gate, on the right.

sentences.text: こちらの　階段から、さらに　下へ　行きます。
sentences.translation: From these stairs, go further down.

sentences.text: 階段を　おりたら、「東京メトロ半蔵門線」・「東急田園都市線」の　ホームへ　行くことが　できる　改札が　あります。

tokens.gloss: to go down, to get off

sentences.translation: Once you go down the stairs, there is a ticket gate that leads to the platforms of the "Tokyo Metro Hanzomon Line" and "Tokyu Den-en-toshi Line."

sentences.text: 2.ホームから「中央改札」へ
sentences.translation: 2. From the platform to the "Central Ticket Gate"

sentences.text: 中央改札へ　行くときは、ホームの　真ん中にある　階段か、エスカレーターで　上に　行きます。
sentences.translation: When going to the Central Ticket Gate, go up using the stairs or escalator in the middle of the platform.

sentences.text: 上に　行く　階段は　ぜんぶ　中央改札へ　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: All the stairs going up lead to the Central Ticket Gate.

sentences.text: だから、「中央改札へ　行きたいときは　階段を　上る」と　おぼえておくと　べんりです。
sentences.translation: So it's convenient to remember, "When you want to go to the Central Ticket Gate, go up the stairs."

sentences.text: 階段を上ると、中央改札があります。
sentences.translation: When you go up the stairs, there is the Central Ticket Gate.

sentences.text: 中央改札の　まわり
sentences.translation: Around the Central Ticket Gate

sentences.text: 3Fにある　中央改札から、近くにある　いろいろな　お店に　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: From the Central Ticket Gate on the 3rd floor, you can go to various nearby shops.

sentences.text: 改札を　出て　すぐに　渋谷スクランブルスクエアがあります。
sentences.translation: Right after exiting the ticket gate is Shibuya Scramble Square.

sentences.text: そして、エスカレーターを　下りて、前に　ある　道を　進むと　渋谷ヒカリエ、右にある　道を　進むと　渋谷ストリームに　行けます。

tokens.gloss: to go down, to get off

sentences.translation: Then, if you go down the escalator and continue along the road in front of you, you'll reach Shibuya Hikarie, and if you go along the road on the right, you'll reach Shibuya Stream.

sentences.text: すべて　建物のなかから　行くことが　できるので、雨の日は　濡れないで　お店に　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: Since you can reach them all from inside the buildings, you can get to the shops without getting wet on rainy days.

sentences.text: | 場所の名前 | 紹介 |
sentences.translation: | Place name | Description |

sentences.text: | 渋谷ヒカリエ | いろいろな　服屋が　ある　建物。
sentences.translation: | Shibuya Hikarie | A building with various clothing stores.

sentences.text: 食事や　スイーツも　楽しめる。
sentences.translation: You can also enjoy meals and sweets.

sentences.text: カフェや　レストランも　　ある。
sentences.translation: There are also cafes and restaurants.

sentences.text: | 渋谷スクランブルスクエア | 高いところから　渋谷の　景色を　見ることが　できる「SHIBUYA SKY(渋谷スカイ)」をはじめ、レストランや　生活で　使う　いろいろな　ものを　買える　店も　ある。
sentences.translation: | Shibuya Scramble Square | Includes "SHIBUYA SKY," where you can view Shibuya's scenery from up high, as well as restaurants and shops selling various everyday items.

sentences.text: | 渋谷ストリーム | カフェや　レストラン、ホテル、ホールなどが　ある　建物。
sentences.translation: | Shibuya Stream | A building with cafes, restaurants, a hotel, a hall, and more.

sentences.text: 1Fでは、ときどき　イベントも　ある。
sentences.translation: On the 1st floor, events are sometimes held.

sentences.text: 銀座線に 乗りかえるとき
sentences.translation: When transferring to the Ginza Line

sentences.text: 中央改札を　出て　左に　進むと、「東京メトロ銀座線」の　改札　があります。
sentences.translation: If you exit the Central Ticket Gate and go left, there is the ticket gate for the "Tokyo Metro Ginza Line."

sentences.text: 歩いて　すぐ　行けます。
sentences.translation: You can get there quickly on foot.

sentences.text: 京王井の頭線に　乗りかえるとき
sentences.translation: When transferring to the Keio Inokashira Line

sentences.text: 「京王井の頭線」に　乗りかえるときは、中央改札から　行くと　わかりやすいです。
sentences.translation: When transferring to the "Keio Inokashira Line," it's easiest to go from the Central Ticket Gate.

sentences.text: 少し　歩きますが、建物のなかの　道を　通るので、雨の日も　濡れないで　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: You'll walk a little, but since you pass through paths inside buildings, you can get there without getting wet even on rainy days.

sentences.text: 中央改札を　出たら　写真の　赤い矢印のほうへ　行きます。
sentences.translation: After exiting the Central Ticket Gate, go in the direction of the red arrow in the photo.

sentences.text: そのまま　進むと、天井が　高くて　広い　場所に　つきます。
sentences.translation: If you keep going straight, you'll arrive at a spacious area with a high ceiling.

sentences.text: ここまで　来たら、もう　少しです！
sentences.translation: If you've made it this far, you're almost there!

sentences.text: 赤い矢印のほうへ　進みます。
sentences.translation: Continue in the direction of the red arrow.

sentences.text: つきました！
sentences.translation: You've arrived!

sentences.text: ここが「京王井の頭線」の　改札です。
sentences.translation: This is the ticket gate for the "Keio Inokashira Line."

sentences.text: 3.ホームから「南改札」へ
sentences.translation: 3. From the platform to the "South Ticket Gate"

sentences.text: JR渋谷駅の　南改札は、駅の　1Fに　あります。
sentences.translation: The South Ticket Gate of JR Shibuya Station is on the 1st floor of the station.

sentences.text: ハチ公改札に　行く　階段ではない　階段を　おりると、南改札に　つきます。

tokens.gloss: to go down, to get off

sentences.translation: If you go down the stairs that are not the ones leading to the Hachiko Ticket Gate, you'll arrive at the South Ticket Gate.

sentences.text: ここが「南改札」です。
sentences.translation: This is the "South Ticket Gate."

sentences.text: 改札を　出て　左に　行くと「西口」、右に　行くと「東口」が　あります。
sentences.translation: Going left after exiting the ticket gate leads to the "West Exit," and going right leads to the "East Exit."

sentences.text: 南改札の　まわり
sentences.translation: Around the South Ticket Gate

sentences.text: 西口を　出ると、前に　バスが　とまる　場所が　あります。
sentences.translation: When you exit the West Exit, there is a bus stop in front of you.

sentences.text: 右に　行くと、ハチ公口に　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: Going right, you can reach the Hachiko Exit.

sentences.text: 左に　行くと　レストランや　カフェが　あります。
sentences.translation: Going left, there are restaurants and cafes.

sentences.text: セルリアンタワー東急ホテルは　左に　あります。
sentences.translation: The Cerulean Tower Tokyu Hotel is on the left.

sentences.text: 10分くらい　歩くと、サンドイッチや、おにぎりなどを　食べられる　カフェ「Tokyo Kenkyo」が　あります。
sentences.translation: If you walk about 10 minutes, there is a cafe called "Tokyo Kenkyo" where you can eat sandwiches, rice balls, and more.

sentences.text: 8：00から　やっているので、朝ごはんを　食べたいときに　オススメです。

tokens.gloss: to be (animate); auxiliary for ongoing state

sentences.translation: Since it's open from 8:00, it's recommended when you want to eat breakfast.

sentences.text: 東口を　出てると、前には　地下鉄の　改札へ　行くことが　できる　エスカレーターが　あります。
sentences.translation: When you exit the East Exit, there is an escalator in front that leads to the subway ticket gate.

sentences.text: 右には　渋谷スクランブルスクエアの　1Fの　入口が　あります。
sentences.translation: On the right is the 1st floor entrance to Shibuya Scramble Square.

sentences.text: 左に　行くと　宮益坂口まで　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: Going left, you can reach the Miyamasuzaka Exit.

sentences.text: | 場所の名前 | 紹介 |
sentences.translation: | Place name | Description |

sentences.text: | 東急プラザ渋谷 | 世界で　有名な「CÉ LA VI(セラヴィ)」や　レストランや　生活で　使うものを　売っている　お店が　たくさん　ある　建物。

tokens.gloss: Ce La Vi (katakana rendering of the brand name)
to be (animate); auxiliary for ongoing state

sentences.translation: | Tokyu Plaza Shibuya | A building with many shops, including the world-famous "CÉ LA VI," restaurants, and stores selling everyday items.

sentences.text: 東京メトロ副都心線・東急東横線に　乗りかえるとき
sentences.translation: When transferring to the Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line / Tokyu Toyoko Line

sentences.text: 地下鉄「東京メトロ副都心線」・「東急東横線」に　乗りかえたいときは、南改札を　出て　「東口」から　行くと　わかりやすいです。
sentences.translation: When you want to transfer to the subway "Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line" or "Tokyu Toyoko Line," it's easiest to exit the South Ticket Gate and go from the "East Exit."

sentences.text: まずは、東口に　ある　こちらの　エスカレーターで、下へ　行きましょう。
sentences.translation: First, use this escalator at the East Exit to go down.

sentences.text: エスカレーターを　降りて　前に　行く、「東京メトロ副都心線」・「東急東横線」のホームに　行くことが　できる　改札が　あります。

tokens.gloss: to get off, to go down

sentences.translation: After going down the escalator and going forward, there is a ticket gate that leads to the platforms of the "Tokyo Metro Fukutoshin Line" and "Tokyu Toyoko Line."

sentences.text: 4.ホームから「新南改札」へ

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: 4. From the platform to the "New South Ticket Gate"

sentences.text: 2024年7月21日から、「新南改札」は　場所が　変わりました。

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: Since July 21, 2024, the location of the "New South Ticket Gate" has changed.

sentences.text: むかしの「新南改札」は　使うことが　できません。

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)
classical negative auxiliary (root behind the -ません negative ending)

sentences.translation: The old "New South Ticket Gate" can no longer be used.

sentences.text: こちらで　紹介する　一番　新しい　行き方を　確認してください。

tokens.gloss: to give (respectful); used in ください ("please")

sentences.translation: Please check the newest route introduced here.

sentences.text: 新しい「新南改札」は、「ハチ公改札」と　反対のほうに　あります。

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: The new "New South Ticket Gate" is on the opposite side from the "Hachiko Ticket Gate."

sentences.text: ホームを　歩いていると　途中、「南改札」と　書いてある　看板が　ありますが、その看板は　関係ありません。

tokens.gloss: to be (animate); auxiliary for ongoing state
classical negative auxiliary (root behind the -ません negative ending)

sentences.translation: While walking along the platform, partway there is a sign that says "South Ticket Gate," but that sign is not relevant.

sentences.text: さらに　前に　進んで　ください。

tokens.gloss: to give (respectful); used in ください ("please")

sentences.translation: Please continue further forward.

sentences.text: ホームを　歩いていくと「新南改札」と　書いてある　エスカレーターが　あります。

tokens.gloss: to go (auxiliary verb, indicates continuing direction)
New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: As you walk along the platform, there is an escalator with "New South Ticket Gate" written on it.

sentences.text: このエスカレーターを　あがると、すぐに「新南改札」が　見えます。

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)
to be visible, to be seen

sentences.translation: When you go up this escalator, you'll immediately see the "New South Ticket Gate."

sentences.text: ここが「新南改札」です。

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: This is the "New South Ticket Gate."

sentences.text: 改札の　近くに、コインロッカー、精算機、お手洗い、そして　駅の　人が　いる　インフォメーションも　あります。

tokens.gloss: to be (animate); auxiliary for ongoing state

sentences.translation: Near the ticket gate, there are coin lockers, a fare adjustment machine, restrooms, and also an information desk staffed by station employees.

sentences.text: 新南改札の　まわり

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: Around the New South Ticket Gate

sentences.text: 「新南改札」から「渋谷サクラステージ」と　「渋谷ストリーム」に　すぐ　行くことが　できます。

tokens.gloss: New South (as in 新南改札, New South Ticket Gate)

sentences.translation: From the "New South Ticket Gate," you can quickly reach "Shibuya Sakura Stage" and "Shibuya Stream."

sentences.text: 改札を　出て　右へ　行くと「渋谷サクラステージ」、左に　行くと「渋谷ストリーム」が　あります。
sentences.translation: Going right after exiting the ticket gate leads to "Shibuya Sakura Stage," and going left leads to "Shibuya Stream."

sentences.text: 道が　わからないときは　案内を　みよう！
sentences.translation: If you don't know the way, let's check the information signs!

sentences.text: JR渋谷駅の　改札を　紹介しました。
sentences.translation: We have introduced the ticket gates of JR Shibuya Station.

sentences.text: 「渋谷駅」には　たくさんの　電車が　通っているので、乗りかえが　難しいです。

tokens.gloss: to commute, to go back and forth (to a place)
to be (animate); auxiliary for ongoing state

sentences.translation: Since many trains pass through "Shibuya Station," transferring can be difficult.

sentences.text: もし　道が　わからないときは　案内を　確認したり、近くの　駅の　人に　聞いてみましょう。

tokens.gloss: listing-action particle ("things like doing X and Y")

sentences.translation: If you don't know the way, let's try checking the information signs or asking nearby station staff.
